remarks: Still searching for the perfect place to rent? Consider this top-floor corner luxury condominium at The Carriage House. This bright and beautifully maintained unit offers 903 square feet of comfortable living space. As a corner unit, it enjoys extra natural light and added privacy. The home features one spacious bedroom and one full bathroom, along with an open-concept kitchen that includes ample countertop space and a cozy nook, perfect for a dining table or breakfast area. The apartment features hardwood floors throughout, enhancing the clean, modern feel from room to room. The living room also boasts soaring cathedral ceilings, adding to the open and airy atmosphere. Additional highlights include central air conditioning, efficient gas heating, and dedicated garage parking. Pets are considered on an individual basis. Conveniently located near I-95 and the Merritt Parkway, with just minutes to the Darien Metro-North station, this home is ideal for commuters. Applicants must have excellent credit with a score of 730+
